entries.text: You were in the military and have friends who still serve. Your former commander remembers you well.
entries.raw_text: 1,You were in the military and have friends who still serve. Your former commander remembers you well.

entries.text: You were the personal guard of a wealthy merchant who accused you of theft. You left her service in disgrace.
entries.raw_text: 1,You were the personal guard of a wealthy merchant who accused you of theft. You left her service in disgrace.

entries.text: You were the bouncer in a local bar for a while, and the patrons there remember you.
entries.raw_text: 1,You were the bouncer in a local bar for a while, and the patrons there remember you.

entries.text: You trained with a highly respected mentor. He regards you well, but he has many enemies.
entries.raw_text: 1,You trained with a highly respected mentor. He regards you well, but he has many enemies.

entries.text: You trained in an isolated monastery far away. The monks think of you as a brother, but you’re a stranger to all others.
entries.raw_text: 1,You trained in an isolated monastery far away. The monks think of you as a brother, but you’re a stranger to all others.

entries.text: You have no formal training. Your abilities come to you naturally (or unnaturally).
entries.raw_text: 1,You have no formal training. Your abilities come to you naturally (or unnaturally).

entries.text: You spent time on the streets and even were in prison for a while.
entries.raw_text: 1,You spent time on the streets and even were in prison for a while.

entries.text: You were conscripted into military service, but you deserted before long.
entries.raw_text: 1,You were conscripted into military service, but you deserted before long.

entries.text: You served as a bodyguard to a powerful criminal who now owes you his life.
entries.raw_text: 1,You served as a bodyguard to a powerful criminal who now owes you his life.

entries.text: You worked as a constable. Everyone knows you, but their opinions of you vary.
entries.raw_text: 1,You worked as a constable. Everyone knows you, but their opinions of you vary.

entries.text: Your older sibling is an infamous glaive who has been disgraced.
entries.raw_text: 1,Your older sibling is an infamous glaive who has been disgraced.

entries.text: You served as a caravan guard. You know a smattering of people in many cities and towns.
entries.raw_text: 1,You served as a caravan guard. You know a smattering of people in many cities and towns.

entries.text: Your best friend is a sage and a scholar. She is a great source of knowledge.
entries.raw_text: 1,Your best friend is a sage and a scholar. She is a great source of knowledge.

entries.text: You and a friend both smoke the same kind of rare, expensive tobacco. The two of you get together weekly to chat and smoke.
entries.raw_text: 1,You and a friend both smoke the same kind of rare, expensive tobacco. The two of you get together weekly to chat and smoke.

entries.text: Your uncle runs a theater in town. You know all the actors and watch all the shows for free.
entries.raw_text: 1,Your uncle runs a theater in town. You know all the actors and watch all the shows for free.

entries.text: Your blacksmith friend sometimes calls on you for help at the forge. However, he pays you well.
entries.raw_text: 1,Your blacksmith friend sometimes calls on you for help at the forge. However, he pays you well.

entries.text: Your mentor wrote a book on the martial arts. Sometimes other warriors seek you out to ask about its stranger passages.
entries.raw_text: 1,Your mentor wrote a book on the martial arts. Sometimes other warriors seek you out to ask about its stranger passages.

entries.text: A man you fought alongside in the military is now the mayor of a nearby town.
entries.raw_text: 1,A man you fought alongside in the military is now the mayor of a nearby town.

entries.text: You saved the lives of a family when their house burned down. They’re indebted to you, and their neighbors regard you as a hero.
entries.raw_text: 1,You saved the lives of a family when their house burned down. They’re indebted to you, and their neighbors regard you as a hero.

entries.text: Your old trainer still expects you to come back and sharpen her blades and clean up after her classes, but when you do, she occasionally shares interesting rumors.
entries.raw_text: 1,Your old trainer still expects you to come back and sharpen her blades and clean up after her classes, but when you do, she occasionally shares interesting rumors.

entries.text: You come from a large family and had to fend for yourself from an early age.
entries.raw_text: 1,You come from a large family and had to fend for yourself from an early age.

entries.text: Your older sister is a skilled nano. You weren’t able to follow her path, but the numenera is not unknown to you.
entries.raw_text: 1,Your older sister is a skilled nano. You weren’t able to follow her path, but the numenera is not unknown to you.

entries.text: You’re a member of a guild of explorers who specialize in uncovering ancient mysteries.
entries.raw_text: 1,You’re a member of a guild of explorers who specialize in uncovering ancient mysteries.

entries.text: You worked alongside your father, who was skilled in many things, until he disappeared one day with no explanation.
entries.raw_text: 1,You worked alongside your father, who was skilled in many things, until he disappeared one day with no explanation.

entries.text: You grew up on the streets and studied at the school of hard knocks.
entries.raw_text: 1,You grew up on the streets and studied at the school of hard knocks.

entries.text: You remember little of your past, which has always seemed strange to you.
entries.raw_text: 1,You remember little of your past, which has always seemed strange to you.

entries.text: You came of age in the wild and are used to living rough.
entries.raw_text: 1,You came of age in the wild and are used to living rough.

entries.text: Your family is wealthy but earns little respect from the locals.
entries.raw_text: 1,Your family is wealthy but earns little respect from the locals.

entries.text: You’re friends with many people in the community and are generally well regarded.
entries.raw_text: 1,You’re friends with many people in the community and are generally well regarded.

entries.text: You have an annoying rival who always seems to get in your way or foil your plans.
entries.raw_text: 1,You have an annoying rival who always seems to get in your way or foil your plans.

entries.text: You’re in love with a local shopkeeper, but that person shows little interest in you.
entries.raw_text: 1,You’re in love with a local shopkeeper, but that person shows little interest in you.

entries.text: Several expeditions preparing to explore old ruins and odd mysteries would like you to join them because you seem like a promising addition to the team.
entries.raw_text: 1,Several expeditions preparing to explore old ruins and odd mysteries would like you to join them because you seem like a promising addition to the team.

entries.text: Your best friend from childhood is now an Aeon Priest.
entries.raw_text: 1,Your best friend from childhood is now an Aeon Priest.

entries.text: You come from a nearby community, but the locals consider the folk of your hometown to be untrustworthy rivals.
entries.raw_text: 1,You come from a nearby community, but the locals consider the folk of your hometown to be untrustworthy rivals.

entries.text: You’re close friends with a local married couple, both of whom are experienced nanos.
entries.raw_text: 1,You’re close friends with a local married couple, both of whom are experienced nanos.

entries.text: You’re drinking buddies with a number of the local guards and glaives.

entries.text: You once saved the child of a local noble from a fire, and she is very grateful.

entries.text: You used to work with a troupe of traveling minstrels and performers, and they remember you fondly (as do people in the places you visited).

entries.text: You served as an apprentice for a nano-sorcerer respected and feared by many people. Now you bear his mark.
entries.raw_text: 1,You served as an apprentice for a nano-sorcerer respected and feared by many people. Now you bear his mark.

entries.text: You studied in a school infamous for its dark, brooding instructors and graduates.
entries.raw_text: 1,You studied in a school infamous for its dark, brooding instructors and graduates.

entries.text: You learned nano-sorcery (or gained your modifications) in the temple of an obscure god. Its priests and worshippers, although small in number, respect and admire your talents and potential.
entries.raw_text: 1,You learned nano-sorcery (or gained your modifications) in the temple of an obscure god. Its priests and worshippers, although small in number, respect and admire your talents and potential.

entries.text: While traveling alone, you saved the life of a powerful abhuman brute. Although unwilling to accompany you on your journey, he remains indebted to you.
entries.raw_text: 1,While traveling alone, you saved the life of a powerful abhuman brute. Although unwilling to accompany you on your journey, he remains indebted to you.

entries.text: Your mother was a powerful nano while she lived, helpful to many locals. They look upon you kindly, but they also expect much from you.

entries.text: You owe money to a number of people around town and don’t have the funds to pay your debts.

entries.text: You learned your skills faster than your teachers had ever seen before. The powers that be took notice and are paying close attention.
entries.raw_text: 1,You learned your skills faster than your teachers had ever seen before. The powers that be took notice and are paying close attention.

entries.text: You trained for a time with a group of Aeon Priests, and they still look upon you with fondness.
